description: This file defines the StorageService interface in the OpenMRS project, responsible for persisting data that does not fit in the database. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, and managing data objects via streams and unique keys, with support for metadata and temporary storage.

classes.name: StorageService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for storing, retrieving, and managing data not suited for traditional database storage, including handling metadata, temporary data, and data lifecycle.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves an InputStream to read data associated with the provided key.

methods.name: getTempData
methods.description: Retrieves temporary data as InputStream using the key.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Fetches metadata related to the data identified by the key.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns a stream of keys starting with a given prefix within a module or group.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Saves data from an InputStream with optional metadata, under a generated key or specified suffix.

methods.name: saveTempData
methods.description: Saves data as a temporary file, either from an InputStream or via a streamer lambda.

methods.name: purgeData
methods.description: Marks data for deletion based on its key.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if data exists for the given key.
